detail.longDescription: Every weather radar app wants your subscription. HookEcho reads NEXRAD Level 2 straight from NOAA. Every tilt, full resolution, velocity, dual-pol, archive back to 1991. Free. MIT. No account, no ads, no telemetry. Runs in your browser or computer: https:// hookecho.io # opensource # rustlang # selfhosted # FOSS # wx # tornado # severewx # stormchasing # NEXRAD # weather
